lines.en: Zoe, did you see the crowd near the old bridge? Everyone was staring at the river.
lines.pt: Zoe, você viu a multidão perto da ponte velha? Todos olhavam fixamente para o rio.

lines.en: I did. My neighbours were wondering whether it was safe to cross after the heavy rain.
lines.pt: Vi. Meus vizinhos estavam se perguntando se era seguro atravessar depois da chuva forte.

lines.en: The council had closed it, so they wondered if it would open again before the weekend.
lines.pt: A prefeitura a fechou, então eles se perguntaram se ela abriria de novo antes do fim de semana.

lines.en: One man wondered whether the engineers had checked the cables properly. I wondered the same thing.
lines.pt: Um homem se perguntou se os engenheiros tinham verificado os cabos direito. Eu me perguntei a mesma coisa.

lines.en: I asked a worker if he knew when the work would finish. He did not seem sure.
lines.pt: Perguntei a um operário se ele sabia quando a obra terminaria. Ele não parecia ter certeza.

lines.en: Typical. A woman beside me wondered what would happen to the cyclists who use it every morning.
lines.pt: Típico. Uma mulher ao meu lado se perguntou o que aconteceria com os ciclistas que a usam toda manhã.

lines.en: I wondered how much the repairs would cost and whether the city could afford them.
lines.pt: Eu me perguntei quanto custariam os reparos e se a cidade poderia pagar por eles.

lines.en: Honestly, I wondered whether it was worth the risk to walk across it last week.
lines.pt: Sinceramente, me perguntei se valia o risco atravessar a pé na semana passada.

lines.en: You did not! I would rather take the long way round, even with the traffic.
lines.pt: Você não fez isso! Eu preferiria ir pelo caminho longo, mesmo com o trânsito.

lines.en: I know, but I could not decide whether to trust the signs or my own eyes.
lines.pt: Eu sei, mas não consegui decidir se confiava nas placas ou nos meus próprios olhos.

lines.en: Let us stay here and wait. Somebody will tell us whether the bridge is open by noon.
lines.pt: Vamos ficar aqui e esperar. Alguém vai nos dizer se a ponte está aberta até o meio-dia.

facts.big: They wondered whether it was safe
facts.label: Dúvidas reportadas
facts.sub: Use wondered whether / if, ordem de afirmação e o verbo no passado: They wondered whether it was safe.

facts.label: perguntou-se se
facts.sub: Use wondered whether + sujeito + verbo no passado: They wondered whether it was safe. Whether é mais formal e combina bem com or: whether to stay or go.

facts.label: perguntou-se se (informal)
facts.sub: If é mais comum na fala: She wondered if it would open again. O sentido é igual a whether, mas if não vem antes de to + verbo.

pages.title: A bridge in Portland · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a damp Saturday morning in Portland. The river is higher than usual after days of rain. Tess and Zoe meet on the street near the old bridge. A small crowd waits behind a yellow barrier. Everyone has questions, but nobody has answers. Today they practise reporting doubts and worries.

“Zoe, did you see the crowd near the old bridge? Everyone was staring at the river.” says Tess. “I did. My neighbours were wondering whether it was safe to cross after the heavy rain.” says Zoe. “The council had closed it, so they wondered if it would open again before the weekend.” says Tess.

paragraphs: “I know, but I could not decide whether to trust the signs or my own eyes.” says Zoe. “Let us stay here and wait. Somebody will tell us whether the bridge is open by noon.” says Tess. At noon a worker puts up a new sign. The bridge will stay closed until Monday. Tess and Zoe walk to the next bridge instead. On the way, they repeat what people wondered. Zoe takes a photo of the river for her sister. With wondered whether, we report doubts politely.
